title: Barbacoa Casserole
description: A twist on traditional Mexican casserole using tender beef barbacoa. This hearty, flavorful dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: Choose barbacoa style for authentic flavor

ingredients.name: Tender Oaxacan Cheese
ingredients.notes: Mild and creamy, perfect for blending flavors

instructions: Cook the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Stir in meat seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, combine shredded cheese, cornmeal, and onion.
In a greased 9x13 inch casserole dish, create a layer of the beef mixture.
Top with the cheese mixture and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
